name: astril - Quantify segmentation masks
desc: Per-class segmentation volumes (mm3) from a set of masks, e.g. after correcting a segmentation run's masks by hand, optionally merging several mask sources per exam first. Segmentation runs already quantify automatically. Versions: astril-nf 0.2.0, astril 0.7.31.
fileRequirementsMessage: Masks in {patient}/{exam}/ folders (or flat). Upload masks and skull-stripped images only -- never raw DICOM/NIfTI or anything not skull-stripped (PHI).
